title: H-bridge motor driver
prompt: Design a printed circuit board for a discrete H-bridge motor driver: four MOSFETs in SOT-23 or larger packages, a 2-pin motor output header, and a 3-pin logic/power input header — at least six footprints. Board outline at most 50mm × 40mm, two copper layers. Declare nets VMOT, GND, OUT_A, OUT_B, and the two gate-drive signals; place components and route every net so its copper is fully connected. Motor current paths (VMOT, OUT_A, OUT_B, GND) should use wide traces. The board must pass a design-rule check clean: no clearance violations, no split nets, no shorts between the half-bridges. Output a .vcad document containing the board as a PcbBoard node.
